people.name: Kirti Ganorkar
people.bio: Kirti Ganorkar has been heading India Business at Sun Pharma since June 2019. He has held various leadership roles across business development, marketing, M&A, new product introduction, project management, IP and litigation. He is a chemical engineer and MBA.

people.name: Aalok Shanghvi
people.bio: Aalok joined Sun Pharma in 2006, handling roles in marketing, R&D, project management, purchase & communications. He became Head of Emerging Markets in 2014 and has served as Whole-time Director since June 2023.
